title: Midnight logo lockup: the ringed moon seal, the name and the tagline in the header and footer
detail: Follow-up to LIVE-1365 (ADR-1885). The Midnight design's header and footer lead with the logo lockup: a 44px ring with a waxing-moon sigil and violet glow, the name in Bodoni, and the Space's tagline under it in Marcellus. components/sites/midnight-logo.tsx draws it from the existing MidnightSeal; site-chrome.tsx passes it as the header brand mark and in the footer for a Midnight site. The .mn-logo rules sit in midnight-blocks-css.ts, tokens only. Still to build from the design: the announcement bar and the richer mist and smoke textures.
